outcome: plasma concentrations of polybrominated diphenyl ethers (PBDEs)
plasma concentrations of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS)
cohort: Ninety-nine self-identified Hispanic women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM), originally enrolled in a GDM cohort study in 1993-1995.
finding: Plasma concentrations of PCBs, OCPs, and BB153 declined more in older women and those who breastfed, while the decline was smaller among women with greater weight loss after delivery.
